# OneDimensionalSpinGlass

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A 1D chain of spins with random ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic bonds, exhibiting frustration and disorder. Serves as a minimal model to explore phase transitions and memory effects that can be mapped to signal propagation in linear network topologies.
